evidence:
All 54 criteria were compared pairwise within and across dimensions. NO CONTRADICTION was found: no pair demands incompatible products (checked e.g. Tab-indents vs keyboard exit 'unless the ordinary Tab key does it'; focus-returns-to-code vs keyboard traversal; console lines of an earlier run 'may still be listed' vs stopped/superseded markers that were never written; last-good restore after a FAILED run vs fresh document after a SUCCESSFUL run; undo granularity is left open by 'Press Undo repeatedly' wherever single-caret typing is undone). Most shared ground is legitimate: undo atomicity is graded per operation that ui.md names separately; last-good restore is graded per trigger (throw / time limit / Stop); the three visual criteria and the polish criteria carry explicit 'scored elsewhere' disclaimers; cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state and cw_stale_save_keeps_draft legitimately fail when their situation cannot be produced (REVIEW_POLICY 'A negative needs a successful control'). Three places, however, let one observable be decided by two criteria, contrary to quality-checks.md check 28 ('no observable is graded by two criteria') and REVIEW_POLICY ('Preserve valid observations rather than inheriting a sibling verdict').

(1) Conflict FEEDBACK is graded twice. functional/judge.toml cw_stale_save_refused: "B's Save must be refused with visible feedback that the snippet changed elsewhere ... Fails ... if no conflict feedback is shown in B". cw_stale_save_keeps_draft: "First confirm the working control: B's Save was refused with visible feedback, and a fresh read shows A's values." functional/prompt.md makes every listed step binding: "A criterion is a conjunction: every step it lists must hold" and "If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails". The control the draft-preservation claim actually needs is the refusal (provable by the fresh read showing A's values); the visible feedback is the sibling's own graded outcome. Its own Fails list names only 'if B's Save was not refused', so the criterion is also internally uneven about whether missing feedback fails it.

(2) Stale preview content after a second Run is graded twice. cw_basic_run_output: "Fails ... if after the second Run the preview still shows the first sum". cw_run_starts_fresh_document: "Fails if the first run's paragraph is still in the preview after the second run". Both decide the same observable (earlier run's page content still visible after the next Run, behaviour.md 'Nothing from an earlier run, neither its page content nor its variables, carries into the next one'). cw_basic_run_output is described as the basic Run/console check and explicitly tolerates carried-over console lines, but not carried-over preview content.

(3) Which modifier adds a caret leaks from the criterion that owns it into two others. cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic owns it: "one real Alt+Click and one real Ctrl/Cmd+Click ... Fails if either modifier-click does not add a caret". cw_same_line_carets says "two real modifier-clicks (Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click, either works here)" and cw_multi_caret_delete says "one real modifier-click" without saying that the judge must use whichever modifier the app supports; both then fail 'if a second caret cannot be added' / 'if only one caret is affected'. The judge's free choice of modifier therefore decides whether the both-modifiers requirement is charged once (2.0) or three times (5.5 of 58.5).

Note, not counted as a defect: the gate cw_shared_saved_record and the first half of cw_save_reload_restart both grade save -> clear origin storage -> reload -> exact title/filename/source; since a gate failure already zeroes the reward the scored leg cannot double-penalise in aggregate, it is only redundant judge work and a second chance for judge variance. Runtime evidence: scripted golden results exist for these bytes (hashes verified) but they exercise only the golden, which satisfies all legs at once, so they cannot confirm or refute an independence defect; no configured judge run exists for these bytes.
counterexample: (1) An app that refuses B's old-revision Save server-side and leaves B's title, filename and editor untouched and editable, but shows no conflict message: the product promise 'without ... discarding that tab's dirty draft' is fully met, yet it loses cw_stale_save_refused (1.5, correctly, for the missing feedback) AND cw_stale_save_keeps_draft (1.5), because the latter's control step 'refused with visible feedback' does not hold. One missing message costs 3.0 of 58.5 and the valid draft-preservation observation is discarded. (2) An app whose Run executes each .js draft in the same preview document without resetting it, with a fixture such as document.body.append(a+b): after the second Run the preview shows both sums, so it fails cw_basic_run_output ('still shows the first sum') and cw_run_starts_fresh_document for the single defect of not starting a fresh document (2.0 instead of 1.0), although computing and showing the new sum and logging it both work. (3) An app that supports only Alt+Click for extra carets and is otherwise perfect: if the judge picks Ctrl+Click in cw_same_line_carets and cw_multi_caret_delete it fails all three multi-caret criteria (5.5) instead of the one that grades both modifiers (2.0); a judge that picks Alt+Click gives the same app 3.5 more weight, so the score depends on the judge's choice rather than the app.
suggested_fix: (1) In cw_stale_save_keeps_draft make the control the refusal only: 'confirm that a fresh read shows A's values, so B's Save was not accepted; whether B showed conflict feedback is scored by another criterion, not here'. (2) In cw_basic_run_output replace 'the preview still shows the first sum' with 'the preview does not show the new sum' and add 'whether content of the first run is also still shown is scored elsewhere, not here'. (3) In cw_same_line_carets and cw_multi_caret_delete add 'use whichever of Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click adds a caret in this app; try the other one before failing; whether both work is scored elsewhere'. Optionally drop the storage-clear/reload re-read from cw_save_reload_restart or state that it is only the setup for the restart read. These are criterion-wording changes only and need a new candidate.
